purpose: Source-backed precedent atlas for financial definitions, leverage tests, and covenant calculation mechanics. Does not invent financial results or claim legal equivalence across instruments.

missingInputRepresentation.rule: Any calculation that requires an input not present in the attested financial fact set must surface MISSING_INPUT explicitly and must not invent a numeric result.

nonGoals: Do not claim term-label equality implies calculation equivalence
Do not modify Definition Encyclopedia or Basket Formula Library owned production files

definitionEncyclopedia.boundary: Encyclopedia owns general defined-term corpus and term identity. WS-FDP owns calculation mechanics, add-back taxonomy, leverage/coverage tests, missing-input rules, and negative condition-vs-capacity examples for financial metrics.

basketFormulaLibrary.boundary: Basket library owns capacity/basket formula taxonomy and permission semantics. WS-FDP records Available Amount / Excess Cash Flow as financial calculation objects and hands capacity-utilization framing to the basket library via published interfaces.

covenantKnowledgeFactory.boundary: Factory owns corpus acquisition. WS-FDP consumes in-repo fixtures only in this draft; future factory document IDs can be linked via sourceId without schema fork.
